{{Quote|Professor Volz's "climatizer" made a ''paradise'' out of this hell-hole!|A Zerm inhabitant|<ref name="TSKR" />}}
'''Zerm''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Description==
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Incredible!'' That ship ''tamed'' our ''weird'' weather&mdash;!''"<br />"''No more ''killer-storms!''<nowiki></nowiki>|Two Zerm inhabitants|<ref name="TSKR" />}}
Zerm was once a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a weird weather and killer-storms. The planet was described by its inhabitants as a [[Chaos/Legends|hell]]-hole.<ref name="TSKR" />

After its [[Terraforming/Legends|transformation]] by the [[Ionic Ring Ship|''Ionic Ring'']], Zerm became a verdant paradise with crops and rainforests.<ref name="TSKR" />

==History==
{{Quote|Ready, Mira&mdash;? We don't want anything to go ''wrong'' with the ''first demonstration'' of my ship&mdash;!|[[Renn Volz]], to his daughter [[Mira Volz|Mira]]|<ref name="TSKR" />}}
[[File:Zerm_2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Ionic Ring Ship|''Ionic Ring'']] transforms the weather on Zerm]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Zerm was a peaceful planet.<ref name="TSKR" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Zerm became the site of the first demonstration of the ''Ionic Ring''. [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Renn Volz]] and his daughter [[Mira Volz|Mira]], at the controls of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], altered the destructive forces of nature on the planet to turn it into a paradise.<ref name="TSKR" />

After this first successful testing, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bzorn]] commandeered the ''Ionic Ring'' with the intent of using it to destroy [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] planets.<ref name="TSKR" />
